fr_html: Lord Phillimore préfère la première solution, mais ajoute que, pour lui, la question n'a pas beaucoup d'importance. Il propose qu'on considère d'abord la première phrase de l'article 15.
en_html: Lord Phillimore preferred the former solution, but added that he did not attach much importance to the question. He proposed that the first sentence of Article 15 should be dealt with first.
